effects.template: 吸取对手{0}点体力，体力低于对手时吸取效果翻倍
反弹{0}倍的伤害给对手并使自身恢复等量体力
反转自身能力下降状态，反转成功则吸取对手{0}点体力
effects.fn: (c,p)=>{if(c.canRemoveNegative?.(c.a)===false)return;let changed=false;for(const k of stats)if(c.a.stages[k]<0){c.a.stages[k]*=-1;changed=true;}if(changed&&c.t.hp>0)healthRules.drainFixed(c,p[0],c.m.name+'反转吸取',c.m.name+'反转吸取');}

effects.template: 吸取对手能力提升状态，吸取成功则吸取对手{0}点体力
附加{0}~{1}点固定伤害并恢复等量体力
后出手时吸取对手{0}点体力
吸取对手{0}点固定体力，自身体力低于1/{1}时吸取效果翻倍
吸取对手能力提升状态，吸取成功则吸取对手{0}点体力，若对手不处于能力提升状态则令对手全属性-{1}
先出手时吸取对手{0}点体力
吸取对手{0}点体力，若对手任意1项技能PP值小于{1}点则吸取效果翻倍

hooks.roundEnd: roundEnd(c){if(!c.a.soulState.fixedTriggered&&c.a.hp>0&&c.t.hp>0)healthRules.drainFixed(c,200,'千夜魂印吸取','千夜魂印吸取');}
roundEnd(c){c.stage(c.a,1,['spa','spe']);if(c.a.hp>0&&c.t.hp>0)healthRules.drainFixed(c,150,'圣甲缪斯吸取','圣甲缪斯吸取');}

hooks.afterUse: afterUse(c){if(c.a.hp<=0||c.t.hp<=0)return;if(c.a.side===c.first){const pool=c.t.moves.filter(id=>c.t.pp[id]>0);if(pool.length){const id=pool[Math.floor(c.random()*pool.length)];c.t.pp[id]=0;c.emit(c.name(c.a)+' 玄武魂印：对手随机技能 PP 归零。');}}else{const n=(c.effective(c.a,'def')+c.effective(c.a,'spd'))*.25;healthRules.drainFixed(c,n,'玄武双防吸取','玄武双防吸取');}}

hooks.roundStart: roundStart(c){const s=c.a.soulState;s.currentRound=c.round;if(c.random()<.5){const pool=['烧伤','冻伤','中毒','麻痹','害怕','睡眠'];c.ailment(c.t,pool[Math.floor(c.random()*pool.length)],c.a);}else s.odinFailedRound=c.round;}
hooks.afterAttack: afterAttack(c){if(c.dealt<=0||c.t.hp<=0)return;const count=Object.values(c.t.ailments).filter(end=>end>=c.round).length;if(count)healthRules.drainFixed(c,150*count,'奥丁魂印吸取','奥丁魂印吸取');}
hooks.roundEnd: roundEnd(c){if(c.a.hp<=0)return;const s=c.a.soulState;if(s.odinFailedRound===c.round){c.heal(c.a,c.a.stats.maxHp/3,'奥丁魂印回复');s.odinPriorityRound=c.round+1;}if(c.t.hp>0&&c.a.hp>c.t.hp)for(const k of Object.keys(c.t.ailments))if(c.t.ailments[k]>=c.round)c.t.ailments[k]=c.round+3;}

hooks.afterUse: afterUse(c){if(c.a.soulState.aioLow&&c.t.hp>0){healthRules.drainFixed(c,200,'艾欧丽娅魂印吸取','艾欧丽娅魂印吸取');}delete c.a.soulState.aioLow;}

hooks.roundEnd: roundEnd(c){if(c.a.hp<=0||c.a.soulState.hypnosLowRound!==c.round)return;if(drain){healthRules.drainFixed(c,healAmount,'修普诺斯魂印吸取','修普诺斯魂印吸取');}else c.heal(c.a,healAmount,'修普诺斯魂印回复');}

souls.name: 跃迁狂剑·兰斯洛特·原魂印

hooks.criticalIncoming: criticalIncoming(c){c.hurt(c.t,c.amount,'兰斯原魂印暴击反弹','fixed');if(c.t.hp>0)healthRules.drainFixed(c,300,'兰斯原魂印吸取','兰斯原魂印吸取');c.timed(c.a,'id984',1,{amount:3},c.round+1);}

hooks.afterAttack: afterAttack(c){if(c.a.hp<=0)return;if((c.settledDamage??c.dealt)>300&&c.t.hp>0){healthRules.drainFixed(c,300,'玛洛迪斯魂印吸取','玛洛迪斯魂印吸取');}else if((c.settledDamage??c.dealt)<300)c.timed(c.a,'必定暴击',1,{},c.round+1);}
